metadata.description: Little mods for the Claude Code terminal: pixel pets and a typing combo above the prompt, a side pane that talks to a fork of the conversation, and a live stock pane.

plugins.name: pixel-parade
plugins.description: Hand-drawn pixel-art cats and dogs wander above the prompt.

plugins.name: typing-combo
plugins.description: A fighting-game combo counter that takes a hit on every keystroke.

plugins.name: vkazas-side
plugins.description: A side pane where you talk to a subagent forked from the main conversation.

plugins.name: vkazas-ticker
plugins.description: A live stock pane with a scrolling tape and intraday sparklines.
